name: Three trays, one oven
description: Three trays of cookies bake one after another in a single oven, onto a rack that holds two. Each tray starts cooling the moment it comes out (instances: "each"); the rack cap is replicates.maxInFlight: 2, so the third bake waits for the first tray to leave the rack rather than stranding a hot tray; boxing waits for every tray (instances: "all"). Per-instance triggers and in-flight limits from program schema 0.3.0-alpha.

metadata.expectedTimingsNote: PRD prd-per-instance-triggers-barriers §7, in seconds. bake-r3 would be ready at 2340 (when bake-r2 ends) but maxInFlight: 2 holds it until cool-r1 frees a rack slot at 2520, so the critical chain is mix -> bake-r1 -> cool-r1 -> (in flight) bake-r3 -> cool-r3 -> box and the makespan is 4440 s (74 min). rack maxConcurrent: 2 alone would NOT give this schedule: it would let bake-r3 run 2340-3060 and then make cool-r3 wait for a rack slot, leaving a hot tray with nowhere to go.
